usage: A countable noun. In Cantonese, it is very common to say 一間博物館 or 呢間博物館 when you talk about a specific museum.
It usually appears with verbs like 去、參觀、睇展覽, because people go there to look at exhibits.
Neutral everyday word. It works well in both spoken Cantonese and formal writing.
For beginner learners, 博物館 is often used as a place name in city talk, travel talk, and school topics about community places.
